founder_direction: Keep current flowing-S logo; symbol alternatives are closed. Continue accepted foundations and short direct-text dark cards.

rules.title: A clear next step.
rules.summary: Familiar controls, quieter surfaces and enough room for the message.
rules.guidance: Keep the current logo. Use the existing type roles and palette; choose a surface for the content it carries.

rules.title: Make the main action obvious.
rules.summary: One strong action. Supporting choices stay quieter.
rules.guidance: Use links for destinations and buttons for actions. Keep labels short, preserve the label while loading, and explain why an action is unavailable.

rules.title: A calm way through the product.
rules.summary: Primary navigation introduces the site. Secondary navigation locates the reader within a topic.
rules.guidance: Dropdowns open on activation, not hover. Tab follows ordinary links; Escape closes an open disclosure and returns focus to its trigger.

rules.title: Give small screens room.
rules.summary: The same labels and hierarchy, with an inline menu that opens below the header.
rules.guidance: Keep controls at least 44px high. Allow labels to wrap. The mobile menu is a disclosure, not a modal; it never traps focus.

rules.title: Let the content choose the card.
rules.summary: A short invitation, a useful tool, and an inspectable result need different compositions.
rules.guidance: Use a single link for a discovery card. Use contained actions for a result. Never nest interactive targets or add a panel just to hold a heading.

rules.title: Make every state understandable.
rules.summary: State changes should explain what happened and what comes next.
rules.guidance: Use text alongside status colour. Keep unavailable controls legible, announce asynchronous outcomes, and remove decorative motion when reduced motion is requested.

limits: Fixture results and local actions; no API call, billing or product proof
Chrome keyboard and responsive checks; screen-reader and cross-browser qualification remain open
No direct text on raster atmospheric images qualified
No full form, modal, table or icon library in this batch
